name: Spinach Dip
description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread

_similar.name: Cornbread Salad
_similar.description: A layered salad with crumbled cornbread, black beans, corn, cheese, and a creamy dressing, perfect for chilling before serving.
recipeIngredient: 1 (11 oz) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz) can black beans, rinsed and drained
½ cup salad dressing or mayonnaise
½ cup chopped fresh cilantro or parsley
6 plum or tiny tim tomatoes, shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and let cool. Crumble into pieces.
In a food processor or blender, combine salad dressing (or mayonnaise), lime juice, cumin, and salt. Process until smooth.
Layer half of the lettuce, cornbread, dressing mixture, beans, corn, cheese, red bell pepper, green onions, and tomatoes in a 4-quart bowl.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining dressing on top. Garnish as desired with cilantro or onion curls.
Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: Cornbread salad, layered salad, Southwestern salad

_similar.name: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts
_similar.description: Sweet and savory bacon-wrapped water chestnuts marinated overnight in a mixture of soya sauce and brown sugar.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown bacon and cut in half.
Roll water chestnuts in white sugar, wrap with bacon, and secure with toothpicks.
Mix brown sugar and soya sauce together.
Pour mixture over bacon-wrapped water chestnuts and marinate overnight.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
